title: COST-CASCADE-MS0
brief: Multi-LLM cost discipline: probe cascades, register all tentacles in the cost model, build the MoA layer-2 aggregator, wrap dispatcher calls with two-pass logic, fallback chain, dashboard, alarm, token-budget guard. Lane-C owns this — strictly serial with K2-CLOUD-MS0 (K2 must be transport-callable before cascade calibration probes it).
